failure_reason: gate_09_budget_consistency failed on 4 deterministic predicates: (1) gate_pass_declaration is 'fail' not 'pass' — the budget_gate_assessment.json and unit_cost_budget.json both declare failure; (2) budget_response_reference is null — no budget artifact is referenced; (3) validation_artifact_reference is null — no validation artifact is referenced; (4) blocking_inconsistencies contains unresolved entry BLOCK-01 — docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/ is effectively empty (only .gitkeep) and the unit-cost derivation (unit_cost_budget.json) has two unresolved blocking components: confirmed_months_unresolved (fellowship duration not confirmed, D11/D12) and host_coefficient_unresolved (host country not confirmed, D11/D12). Per CLAUDE.md §8.4 (C1 constitutional amendment), for MSCA-PF (budget_regime: unit_cost) every budget component in the §8.1 deterministic derivation must resolve to Confirmed or operator-declared Assumed before this gate passes. An incomplete derivation constitutes the same blocking gate failure as an absent lump-sum response. Phase 8 is categorically blocked (CLAUDE.md §8.4, §13.4). Hard block is in effect.
resolution_path: Resolve the two unresolved blocking components in unit_cost_budget.json by confirming or operator-declaring (D11/D12): (a) fellowship duration in months (confirmed_months), and (b) host country to resolve living-allowance coefficient (host_country_coefficient_percent). Once both components resolve to Confirmed or Assumed, re-run the unit-cost budget deriver (CLAUDE.md §8.1 byte-equal replay check), update budget_gate_assessment.json with populated budget_response_reference and validation_artifact_reference, and re-invoke gate_09 evaluation.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §6.2 (gates are mandatory; phase not complete until gate condition satisfied), §7 Phase 7 gate condition (budget gate, instrument-conditional per C1), §8.1 (unit-cost deterministic derivation; confirmed_months × published_rates × host_country_coefficient), §8.4 (categorical Phase-8 block unconditional and instrument-independent; incomplete unit-cost derivation is a blocking gate failure), §12.4 (missing mandatory inputs trigger gate failure), §13.4 (no Phase 8 activity before budget gate passes), §15 (prefer explicit gate failure over fabricated completion)
